description: kalide turns a folder of Markdown files into a slide deck and shows it in your browser.
pre_install: if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($token)) { throw 'kalide: no GitHub token found. Set KALIDE_GITHUB_TOKEN (or GITHUB_TOKEN) to a token that can read the private repository really-knows-ai/kalide, then run ''scoop install kalide'' again. See INSTALL.md.' }

try { $release = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('https://api.github.com/repos/' + $repo + '/releases/tags/' + $tag) -Headers $apiHeaders } catch { $status = [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode; throw ('kalide: could not read release ' + $tag + ' from ' + $repo + ' (HTTP ' + $status + '). Check that your token is valid and has access to the private repository. See INSTALL.md.') }

if ($null -eq $releaseAsset) { throw ('kalide: release ' + $tag + ' has no asset named ' + $asset + '. This release may not include the ' + $architecture + ' build; see INSTALL.md for supported Windows targets.') }

try { Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $releaseAsset.url -Headers $downloadHeaders -OutFile $kalidePath -UseBasicParsing } catch { $status = [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode; throw ('kalide: could not download ' + $asset + ' from release ' + $tag + ' (HTTP ' + $status + '). Check your token and network connection. See INSTALL.md.') }

if ($actual.ToLower() -ne $expected.ToLower()) { Remove-Item -Path $kalidePath -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; throw ('kalide: SHA-256 check failed for ' + $asset + ' (expected ' + $expected + ', got ' + $actual + '). The download was discarded; do not use it.') }
notes: kalide is downloaded from the private GitHub Release really-knows-ai/kalide.
Set KALIDE_GITHUB_TOKEN (or GITHUB_TOKEN) to a GitHub token that can read that private repository before installing; without it the install stops with a clear message.
Windows ARM: the arm64 entry is present only for releases that shipped a windows/arm64 binary.
